title: Kura Oncology’s KOMZIFTI sees refill surge over new prescriptions
digest: Kura Oncology reported that refill prescriptions for KOMZIFTI have surpassed new prescriptions, signaling increased demand for the therapy (Seeking Alpha, Nov 17, 2026). The company cited its ‘资金桥接计划’ (financial bridge program) as critical for sustaining growth, though success hinges on meeting specific milestones and maintaining fiscal discipline. Analysts note the refill-to-new ratio has grown from 1.2x in Q3 to 1.8x in Q4, with 78% of prescribers indicating continued use (unpublished internal data). The surge reflects KOMZIFTI’s dominance in a niche oncology market, but long-term viability depends on whether the company can secure additional funding beyond its $120M existing war chest without diluting equity beyond 15% (Kura investor presentation, Nov 2026).
